{{Quote|Statistically, it should take approximately five hundred thousand years for our escape pod to be located in this sector.|[[SP-99]], to [[Satele Shan]]|<ref name="The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant">''[[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant]]''</ref>}}
The '''Kuat sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Home to the [[Kuat system/Legends|Kuat system]], it also contained the systems of [[Redrish system/Legends|Redrish]], [[Drurish system/Legends|Drurish]], [[Ulion system/Legends|Ulion]], [[Kidir system/Legends|Kidir]], [[Monadin system/Legends|Monadin]], [[Renegg system/Legends|Renigg]], [[Venir system/Legends|Venir]], and [[Horthav system/Legends|Horthav]].

==History==
[[File:RepublicTransportShip-TORToC1.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A [[Republic transport ship]] travels through the Kuat sector]]

[[Risi Lenoan]] and later [[Giddean Danu/Legends|Giddean Danu]] represented Kuat sector in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. [[Viqi Shesh]] represented the sector in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]].

During Imperial control, certain routes were established within the [[Inner Kuat Transfer Zone|Kuat Traffic Zone]], restricting four systems to access a [[Kuat Passenger Port|passenger port]] at [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], four systems to access a [[Kuat Freight Port|freight port]], and four unknown systems that could access an [[Imperial Transfer Post|Imperial port]].
